_README: Curated rows of the security master (src/data_extract/utils/common/security_master.py). Every entry cites a URL or an SEC accession in `source`; an entry without one is refused at load.

conversion_ratios: dated number of canonical-class shares one share of `cusip` is worth, half-open trade dates [valid_from, valid_to) (null = open). Only contractual ratios live here; every other common class is 1.

market_boundaries: CUSIP-qualified role and issuer over half-open trade dates; they override the derived issuer and the lineage-window role for that CUSIP. role is one of canonical_predecessor, canonical_current, secondary_class, acquired_constituent, excluded (excluded rows name the reason).
class_overrides: {cusip, security_class, source} for a line whose class evidence the FTD description does not carry.
merger_metadata: the boundary-day facts the insider lineage (Q2f) reads. The financial-statement register keeps its own meaning.

co_registrants: subsidiary CIKs that file event forms under the parent's symbol and whose rows are not stored (decision D-Q2-1). The identity-flags rule finds the ones beside a roster window (DLR LP, PG&E utility, PPL Electric, ONEOK); the curated ones it never judges are listed here.

exchange_ratios: the merger exchange ratio of each register predecessor window whose vendor series replaces the canonical one (decision P31): one share of predecessor_cik became `ratio` shares of the ticker on seam_date. The merged fundamentals history multiplies the window owner's share counts and divides its per-share figures by ratio x the ticker's splits after the seam; the PIT share count stays the owner's as-filed count.

deferred_to_traded_security: tickers whose history waits for the traded-security realignment of plan §13.10 (user 2026-10-05), each citing that decision in `source`. `predecessor_series` (P38): the D-Q2-8 replacement of the canonical vendor rows inside the register predecessor window is not applied, so its exchange ratio is not used either; Sharadar's own rows, aligned with the traded security's prices, stay. `event_filing_windows` (P40): 8-K and 13D/13G union over every CIK of the entity, undated, as before P35 (listing, schedule guards, identity-propagate purge, validate identity and the regression gate). Read by src/utils/traded_security_deferrals.py.

conversion_ratios.evidence: Each Class A share converts into 30 Class B shares before the 50-for-1 Class B split approved on 2010-01-20 (8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000115752310000241/); FTD A/B price ratio p50 30.36 before 2010-01-21.
After the 50-for-1 Class B split effective 2010-01-21 one Class A share converts into 30 x 50 = 1,500 Class B shares; FTD A/B price ratio p50 1,500.2 from 2010-01-21.

market_boundaries.evidence: Delphi Automotive PLC traded as DLPH from its 2011-11-17 IPO (first FTD row settles 2011-11-22) until the 2017-12-04 spin-off of Delphi Technologies and the rename to Aptiv PLC (8-K Items 2.01, 5.03 filed 2017-12-07); APTV (G6095L109) from 2017-12-05. Decision P20.
New News Corp Class A began regular-way trading on 2013-07-01 after the 2013-06-28 separation (8-K Items 5.03, 8.01 filed 2013-07-03). Decision P20.
Exxon Mobil Corp common until the holding-company reorganisation (8-K Items 2.01, 3.03 of ExxonMobil Holdings Corp filed 2026-07-01); the old CUSIP's last FTD row settles 2026-07-02. Decision P20.

ExxonMobil Holdings Corp common from 2026-07-02; the XOMZZZZ placeholder at $0.01 settles that day and is excluded. The CIK window of 0002115436 starts 2026-07-01 (registrant_cutover.json). Decision P20.
Fox Corporation Class A from the 2019-03-19 separation from 21st Century Fox (8-K Items 2.01, 3.03, 5.03 filed 2019-03-19). Decision P20.

Google Class A is the canonical line throughout: traded as GOOG until 2014-04-03, as GOOGL from the 2014-04-03 Class C dividend (8-K Item 3.03 filed 2014-03-26), bounded by its own last observation, then Alphabet 02079K305. Class C 38259P706 is a secondary class. Decision P20.
Chesapeake Energy common as CHK from the first FTD row (2009-07-01) until its 2020-04 reverse split, bounded by the CUSIP's own observations. Decision P20.
Post-reverse-split Chesapeake common (CHK, then CHKAQ in bankruptcy) until the old equity was cancelled at emergence on 2021-02-09 (8-K Items 1.02, 3.03, 5.03 filed 2021-02-09).
CHKAQ fails still settling after the 2021-02-09 cancellation; they overlap the new CUSIP 165167735 for 6 settlement days and are never summed with it.
New Chesapeake common issued at the 2021-02-09 emergence (CHK, EXE from 2024-10-02).

Discovery Series A common (DISCA) ceased trading on Nasdaq after the close of the 2022-04-08 Closing Date of the WarnerMedia merger (8-K Items 2.01, 3.01, 3.03, 8.01 filed 2022-04-12); its last FTD fail settles 2022-04-12 (trade date 2022-04-08). Decision §13.2.

Warner Bros. Discovery common commenced trading on Nasdaq as WBD on 2022-04-11 (8-K Item 8.01 filed 2022-04-12); its FTD rows settling 2022-04-11/12 carry trade dates 2022-04-07/08, before WBD traded. Decision §13.2.

merger_metadata.evidence: Merck / Schering-Plough reverse merger consummated on 2009-11-03 (8-K of CIK 0000310158 filed 2009-11-04); the closing after the 16:00 close is decision P25. On the boundary day a row reporting SGP is acquired_constituent; under 0000310158 code A rows are canonical_current and code D/J rows acquired_constituent; rows under 0000064978 are canonical_predecessor.

AMB / ProLogis merger consummated on 2011-06-03 (8-K Items 2.01, 3.03, 5.03 of CIK 0001045609 filed 2011-06-08; the filing states no closing time). AMB rows before the seam are acquired_constituent; rows under 0000899881 are canonical_predecessor.

exchange_ratios.evidence: Reverse merger: AMB Property Corp (CIK 0001045609, the legal acquirer) renamed Prologis, Inc.; each Old ProLogis common share became one New Pumpkin share, then 'each outstanding share of New Pumpkin common stock was converted into 0.4464 shares of Prologis common stock' (8-K Item 2.01 of CIK 0001045609 filed 2011-06-08; also Item 5.07 of CIK 0000899881 accession 0000950123-11-057282). PLD's pre-seam price history is AMB's.

Dow / DuPont merger of equals under DowDuPont Inc. (CIK 0001666700): each DuPont common share 'was converted into the right to receive 1.2820 fully paid and non-assessable shares of DowDuPont Common Stock'; each Dow share into one (8-K Item 8.01 of CIK 0000030554 filed 2017-09-01). DD's pre-seam price history is Dow Chemical's (its 2000-06-19 3:1 split is in prices_splits).

Praxair / Linde AG combination under Linde plc (CIK 0001707925): each Praxair share 'was converted into the right to receive one ordinary share ... of Linde plc'; Linde AG shares were exchanged at 1.540 (8-K Item 2.01 of CIK 0000884905 filed 2018-10-31; also 0001193125-18-313073 of CIK 0001707925). LIN's pre-seam price history is Praxair's (its 2003-12-16 2:1 split is in prices_splits).

Westar Energy / Great Plains Energy merger under Evergy (CIK 0001711269): each Westar share 'was converted into the right to receive one ... share of common stock ... of Evergy'; each Great Plains share into 0.5981 (8-K Item 8.01 of CIK 0000054507 filed 2018-06-04). EVRG's pre-seam price history is Westar's.

Baker Hughes / GE Oil & Gas: each Baker Hughes share 'will be converted into the right to receive one share of Class A common stock' of the new company plus a special dividend of $17.50 per share (8-K Item 1.01 of CIK 0000808362 filed 2016-11-01; the 2017-03-27 amendment, 0000950103-17-003027, keeps 100% of Class A with the Baker Hughes holders); consummated 2017-07-03 (8-K 0001193125-17-220950). BKR's pre-seam price history is Baker Hughes Inc's; the 2017-07-05 price drop is the $17.50 dividend, not a share-basis change.

STERIS Corp / Synergy Health combination under STERIS plc (CIK 0001624899): each STERIS US share 'was converted into the right to receive one New STERIS Share'; each Synergy share received 0.4308 New STERIS Shares and 439 pence (8-K Item 2.01 of CIK 0000815065 filed 2015-11-06; also 0001193125-15-370270 of CIK 0001624899). STE's pre-seam price history is STERIS Corp's (its 1998-08-25 2:1 split is in prices_splits).

deferred_to_traded_security.evidence: Yahoo's pre-seam PLD prices are AMB's (CUSIP 00163T109; 2011-04-01 Yahoo 36.04 = AMB 36.04, old ProLogis 15.98; first bar 1997-11-21 = AMB IPO) while the register predecessor is old ProLogis 0000899881. Sharadar's PLD rows before 2011-06-03 are AMB's and stay; AMB's (CIK 0001045609) pre-merger 8-K / 13D / 13G stay PLD's.

Yahoo's pre-seam JCI prices are Tyco's (H89128104 / G91442106; 2011-04-01 Yahoo 23.55 = Tyco 45.25 / 2.0117 / 0.955; the 2007, 2012 and 2016 split events are Tyco's) while the register predecessor is old Johnson Controls 0000053669. Tyco's (CIK 0000833444) pre-merger 8-K / 13D / 13G stay JCI's.

Yahoo's pre-seam DD prices are Dow Chemical's (the 2000-06-19 3:1 split is Dow Chemical's) while the register predecessor is old DuPont 0000030554. Sharadar's DD rows before 2017-08-31 are Dow Chemical's and stay; the event filings of every CIK of DD's entity stay DD's, undated.
